name: Sniper Tag 🎯
desc:
A sniper is passed from player to player. 🔫
You get the rifle, you shoot someone. 🎯
You don’t, you explode. 💥

Outplay, outlast, and pass the sniper before time runs out.

Win rounds, earn coins, unlock skins for your gun and death effects.

🕹️Press C to slide, F to enter always-on scope mode until you shoot. For any other platform, press keys and you will find out which does what.
🏆Chat tags is only for users on All-TIme Leaderboards.
❗Do not cheat, cheating will result in being banned. We want legit players, not people that want to "troll" people/similar. If you are caught cheating, via reports or such then you will be banned.
🤖Do not use alternative accounts to farm or such (farming off your friends/similar also counts), this semi-counts as Cheating, WILL result in loss of your in-game player data and similar. Join Community Server for most rules.

(Game is in beta, feel free to report any bugs or give suggestions)

Credits to RTPN Official and DM DOKURO for some used songs.
